text: Did our little mage remember their Mana Flower today? I packed one for them. Just in case.
{Mate} set my hair on fire and then apologized for ten minutes. I told them it's fine. It's always fine. They're doing their best.
Somebody give the mage a Mana Regeneration Potion, they've been trying so hard!
I watched {Mate} miss the boss eleven times in a row and then hit the Guide. I've never been prouder.
The mages are out of mana again. Let them sit down. Let them have a snack. They've earned it.
Everyone keeps tucking me in after boss fights. I don't know why, but it's really nice!
Don't tell {Mate} the Water Bolt bounced back and hit them. Just let them have this one.
I'm a normal ranger. I have normal bullets. I aim them in a normal way. Thank you for asking.
Chlorophyte bullets? What are those? I've never heard of those. Is that a type of plant?
Hey {Mate}! Lovely weather! Just a normal person enjoying the weather, with my normal gun.
I bought these bullets from the Arms Dealer. Regular. Completely regular. Please stop looking at them.
Whoa, nice shot, me! Totally aimed that one. On purpose. With my eyes.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: {Mate} is so brave, standing back like that, waiting for the perfect moment. I hope they know we all look up to them.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: Nobody talks to me after the fights. I think they're mad I didn't charge in. I'll do better.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: {Mate} said 'good job' to me today. I think it was sarcastic. It had to be sarcastic.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: Whenever {Mate} swings that sword from across the arena, I feel safe. I'd never tell them, though. It'd go to their head.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: My Starfury drops stars from the sky and I get the credit. I don't deserve the credit. The sky deserves the credit.

group: Melee, who don't know they're loved
text: Everyone went quiet when I walked into the barracks. They definitely know. They know I've never touched a boss.
{Fancy} is wearing a full set of Hallowed armor to guard a dirt wall. Very humble. Very down to earth.
{Glutton} has {GluttonKills} kills. Wow. Incredible. I'm so happy for them. Really.
{Tank} has died {TankDeaths} times and still shows up to every fight. Total legend. Absolute icon. Someone please stop them.
{Bravest} only has {BravestHP} health and they still go in first. Show-off.
{Laziest} drank every Lesser Healing Potion in the armory and said it was 'for morale.'
K'Or'Arath, god of firestorms, doesn't support summon slop! He used real magic weapons, just like us!
I miss Cthulhu so much. He would never have stood by while homing bullets were around. Wait, who are we trying to stop?
Ul'Thazhra the Unblinking sees every soul that has ever lived. She thinks the Guide's hat is a bad choice.
Vorrath of the Thousand Teeth demands blood every Blood Moon. He also really wants us to try the Tavernkeep's ale. He says it's underrated.
The Drowned One whispers to me in my sleep. Mostly about how the Angler should be nicer to people.
K'Or'Arath burned seven kingdoms to ash for using summon staves. He also loves cats. Huge cat guy.
I asked Mother Gnash what she thinks of the Tax Collector. The silence that followed will haunt me forever.
Our lord Ixxethra devours stars. He hates it when people chew with their mouths open. Fix that, {Mate}.
The old gods are very clear on this. Minions are an abomination. Pets are fine. Pets are adorable.
My Imp Staff does all my emails. I mean, my fighting. It does all my fighting.
Once I get a Stardust Dragon Staff, I'm never lifting a finger again. I am going to lift exactly zero fingers.
I upgraded from the Slime Staff to the Finch Staff. That's called growth, {Mate}.
Why would I learn to use a sword when my Spider Staff already knows how? Work smarter!
The Optic Staff gives me two minions for the price of one. That's just good business.
This is just like that one video where the guy runs from the giant wall! Wait. Is that us? Is that video us?
My implant updated overnight. I know three new emotes now. I can't stop using them.
I respawned right next to the Nurse and she charged me anyway. For what? I was already alive!
